requirements_summary: Primary workload: enterprise code search + internal engineering docs (mono-repo + multi-repo), ~50M embedding vectors target first year
Indexing cadence: near-real-time deltas (hourly) + full reindex window nightly; frequent branch merges cause high churn
Query profile: low-latency developer queries (interactive), P95 end-to-end target <400ms, P50 <120ms
Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query <$0.003 including embedding + vector fetch + rerank for standard dev queries
Reranking strategy: two-stage — sparse candidate retrieval -> dense embedding recall -> LLM/ML reranker for top-20; prefer running reranker on-device/near the index to reduce network hop
Model preferences: open quantized models for rerank (Llama2 variants), standard embedding model preference is 1536-d dense vectors but open to Redwood-recommended profile
Availability: require VPC/private control plane with audit logging and KMS; SSO/SAML with SCIM provisioning
Scaling: sharded vector index across 3 regions with cross-region failover; warm KV cache for hot repos
